title: Cyan Sunset
description: Cyan Sunset is the PERFECT mod pack to start with, it adds Sodium, Appleskin, Chatheads, Jade, Simple Voice Chat, Xaeros Minimap/World Map and features that'll make you wonder why they aren't in the game.
body:
# 🌅 Cyan Sunset

> *The starter modpack that quietly upgrades **everything**.*

## ✨ Why Cyan Sunset?

Ever installed one mod... then another... then twenty more... only to end up with a cluttered mess?

**Cyan Sunset** skips that part.

It bundles together the kinds of mods that feel so natural you'll forget they aren't part of Minecraft. Better performance, cleaner visuals, more useful information, improved exploration, and countless quality-of-life features that quickly become impossible to give up.

## 🌍 What You'll Love

- 🚀 **Massive performance improvements** for smoother gameplay
- 🎨 **Beautiful shader support** and enhanced graphics
- 🗺️ **Minimap & world map** so getting lost becomes optional
- 🍗 **Food and saturation info** right where you need it
- 🔍 **Block and entity tooltips** that save endless guessing
- 🎤 **Built-in voice chat** for multiplayer adventures
- 📹 **Replay and free camera tools** for screenshots and cinematics
- 🛠️ **Dozens of polished quality-of-life features** that simply make Minecraft more enjoyable

> ✨ **All of this with fewer than a dozen carefully chosen mods.** No bloated installation, no unnecessary extras, just the features that make Minecraft feel better from the moment you start playing.

## 💎 Vanilla... but Better

No giant tech mods.  
No complicated magic systems.  
No overwhelming progression.

Just a carefully chosen collection of improvements that make Minecraft feel like it evolved naturally.
